tools.name: ax_overview
tools.description: The map of Designing for Agents, the AX Field Guide: 15 design heuristics for interfaces AI agents use, in 4 groups and 5 session phases, plus a 55-term lexicon. A good first call. Example: ax_overview()

tools.name: ax_search
tools.description: Find heuristics and lexicon terms by meaning words. Returns short cards (id, title, one-line law or definition, full_tokens = cost of reading the full entry). An empty query lists entries of the chosen type in order. Example: ax_search(query="stale reads", type="heuristic", limit=5)

tools.name: ax_get
tools.description: Open one heuristic or lexicon term at the depth you need. card (~60 tokens): the law or definition. summary (~300–600 tokens): for a heuristic, the fix, the review checklist, trace signals, trade-offs and key terms. full: the whole article as text (its size is full_tokens). Example: ax_get(id="H-11"

tools.name: ax_traverse
tools.description: Walk the links from one entry without reading its text. Relations: tensions (heuristics it pulls against), allies (heuristics it works with), terms (lexicon terms it teaches or relates to), heuristics (heuristics that cite or address it), phase (other heuristics in the same session phase), all.
